digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and persistent repository clone
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone that predate the A6-0b deployment and are not committed to the authoritative tickets branch.
The TICKET_DIGEST.json is a superseded unsigned derived-cache artifact with a later usable digest already committed in authoritative history and cannot become authoritative.
The CLAIM_ENRICH.json is an expired queue entry with an expired lease and a later committed claim and DONE state in authoritative history.
Both files must be verified to match their recorded SHA-256 hashes and be the only untracked files before authorized disposal to avoid data loss.
After cleanup, the persistent review-bot clone must have no untracked event files, HEAD equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets, and no merge, rebase, or stash state before A6-1 publication.
